notes: The annual is the quarterly with more time and more strategic depth. It is not a reset. It extends what the quarterlies built.
Day 1 validates the strategy and creates the new 3HAG. Day 2 builds the annual plan and the first quarter of it.
This is a working session. Protect time for the team to make decisions and capture its own plan.
